第34章 赶年集，买年货-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

中午的饭是林国强做的。

红烧肉、醋溜白菜、西红柿鸡蛋汤，还有一大盘卤味。

赵志军吃了三碗饭，撑得直打嗝。

“三姐夫，你做的饭也太好吃了。

我以后娶媳妇，得找个做饭跟你一样好的。”

“那你得打一辈子光棍了。”赵素梅笑着说。

“三姐，你这话说的……”赵志军不乐意了，“我三姐夫这样的，天底下又不是只有一个。”

“就一个。”林国强夹了一块红烧肉放进嘴里，慢悠悠地说，“独一份。”

赵素梅笑着捶了他一下。

赵志军看着他们两个，忽然觉得，这大概就是最好的日子。

有饭吃，有活干，有人疼。

腊月二十八，林国强去取了木马。

老木匠的手艺确实不错，马头雕得有模有样，鬃毛用刻刀划出一道道细纹，马眼睛点了两点黑漆，亮晶晶的。

整体打磨得很光滑，摸着不扎手，底下是两块弧形的木板，能摇。

林国强付了剩下的三块钱，把木马绑在自行车后座上，驮回家。

林静正在院子里跟林薇玩。

其实是她玩，林薇坐在旁边看。

看见林国强推着自行车进来，后座上绑着一个大家伙，林静愣住了。

“爸，这是啥？”

“木马，给你的。”

林国强把木马解下来，放在院子里，拍了拍上面的木屑。

林静围着木马转了两圈，伸手摸了摸马头，又缩回去了，不敢骑。

“怕啥？上去试试。”林国强把她抱起来，放在木马背上。

林静两只手抓着马耳朵，身体绷得紧紧的，不敢动。

林国强轻轻推了一下木马，木马摇了起来，前后晃悠，发出“吱呀吱呀”的声音。

林静先是紧张得脸都白了，晃了两下之后，忽然笑了。

“爸！它在动！它在摇！”

“喜欢不？”

“喜欢！”林静松开马耳朵，两只手举起来，像是要飞一样，“爸，你看我！我自己能摇！”

她身体前后晃着，木马跟着她的节奏摇了起来，越摇越高，她笑得前仰后合。

The lunch meal was cooked by Lin Guoqiang.

Braised pork, vinegar cabbage, tomato and egg soup, and a big plate of braised meat.

Zhao Zhijun ate three bowls of rice and hiccupped.

"Third brother-in-law, the food you cook is so delicious.

When I get a wife in the future, I have to find someone who can cook as well as you."

"Then you will have to be a bachelor for the rest of your life." Zhao Sumei said with a smile.

"Third sister, what you said..." Zhao Zhijun was unhappy, "My third brother-in-law is not the only one in the world."

"Just one." Lin Guoqiang put a piece of braised pork into his mouth and said slowly, "Only one."

Zhao Sumei smiled and punched him.

Zhao Zhijun looked at the two of them and suddenly felt that this was probably the best day.

There is food to eat, there is work to do, and there are people who feel pain.

On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth lunar month, Lin Guoqiang went to get the wooden horse.

The old carpenter's craftsmanship is indeed good. The horse's head is carved in a stylish way, the mane is carved with fine lines with a carving knife, and the horse's eyes are shiny with two dots of black paint.

The whole thing is polished very smooth and does not irritate your hands. There are two curved wooden boards underneath that can be shaken.

Lin Guoqiang paid the remaining three yuan, tied the wooden horse to the back seat of his bicycle, and carried it home.

Lin Jing was playing with Lin Wei in the yard.

In fact, she was the one playing, while Lin Wei sat and watched.

Lin Jing was stunned when she saw Lin Guoqiang pushing his bicycle in with a big guy tied to the back seat.

"Dad, what is this?"

"Trojan horse, it's for you."

Lin Guoqiang untied the wooden horse, placed it in the yard, and patted the sawdust on it.

Lin Jing circled around the wooden horse twice, stretched out her hand to touch the horse's head, then retracted it, not daring to ride.

"What are you afraid of? Go up and try." Lin Guoqiang picked her up and put her on the back of the wooden horse.

Lin Jing held the horse's ears with both hands, her body tensed and she didn't dare to move.

Lin Guoqiang pushed the wooden horse gently, and the wooden horse started to shake, swaying back and forth, making a "squeaking" sound.

Lin Jing was so nervous that her face turned pale at first. After shaking for a moment, she suddenly smiled.

"Dad! It's moving! It's shaking!"

"Do you like it?"

"I like it!" Lin Jing let go of the horse's ears and raised her hands as if she wanted to fly, "Dad, look at me! I can shake it myself!"

She rocked back and forth, and the wooden horse swayed to her rhythm, swaying higher and higher, and she laughed so hard.
